# solidping_channel (Data Source)

Look up an existing notification channel by `uid` or by `name`. This is how a Slack channel, which Terraform cannot create, is referenced.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Slack channels are created by installing the Slack app: look them up by name.
data "solidping_channel" "slack_ops" {
  name = "#ops-alerts"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Name of the channel. Exactly one of `uid` and `name` must be set. The lookup fails when several channels share the name.
- `uid` (String) UID of the channel. Exactly one of `uid` and `name` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether notifications are sent to this channel.
- `id` (String) UID of the channel.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether new checks notify this channel by default.
- `settings` (String) Type-specific settings, as a JSON object (secrets excluded). Read it with `jsondecode`.
- `type` (String) Channel type (`slack`, `webhook`, `email`, ...).
